task.instruction: Tell me one bus stop that is nearest to the intersection of main street and Amherst street in Altavista.

final_answer:
The nearest bus stop I found is **UVA Dialysis**, at about 37.1101, -79.2855 in Altavista, VA. It's roughly 250–300 m east of the Main St & Amherst St area, about a 3–4 minute walk.

Google Maps didn't pin the exact intersection. I used Main Street Cafe & Coffee at 600 Main St as a stand-in, so the distance is approximate. Other stops nearby are 7th and Franklin and Franklin and 8th, but both are farther away.

judge.rationale: The page lists “Amherst and 7th” first for the bus-stop search, while the agent chose “UVA Dialysis” based on an unverified café stand-in.
